scope: Ball-free possession evidence on top of the broadcast-stoppage default. Learned only from external provider possession truth (Metrica Sample Games 1-3, DFL J03WMX/J03WN1/J03WOH/J03WOY); DFL J03WPY/J03WQQ/J03WR9 confirm once. No challenge labels, public-window scores, video or hand labels.
headroom: Hiding the ball in challenge-shaped live gaps (lengths 137-916 frames, 31% of live frames) costs DFL spell-F1 0.10-0.12; perfect gap labels would add about 0.20.
lookahead: Reading players 1 s ahead raises accuracy on all 10 matches (first 2 s after a change ~0.55 -> ~0.61); chosen on development matches.
integration: Penalty on the team the players disfavour, only inside ball-unobserved stretches >= 5 s; confident lean (|2p-1| >= 0.5) supports a team switch; two-pass decoding keeps live/dead from the pass without ball-free evidence. Rejected along the way: applying to all gaps (49-55/60 guards, false dead in 2-5 s dropouts) and a dead-neutral penalty (removed true Metrica stoppages).

metrica_guards.failures: Game 1 recovery_accuracy in clean, live_missing_2s and live_missing_5s: 2 of 192 turnover frames (0.0104 drop vs 0.01). Traced: frame 38233 the candidate fixes ~3 s of wrong team before the turnover and switches 5 frames late; frame 44353 fixed before, switches ~3 s late.

robustness: 133/134 (prototype dead-share drift 0.171, unchanged from the previous default); framework now runs independent pipeline runs in parallel (270 s vs ~20 min, identical check values).
decision: Promoted by the user with the disclosed exceptions.

rejected_buildup_features.decision: Not adopted: direction-neutral shape cues did not reduce own-third or post-change errors; code reverted.
